forensic_science_laboratory_report.laboratory: Forensic Science Laboratory, Rohini, New Delhi

exhibits_received.description: Accused's fingerprint card (10 prints) for comparison

fingerprint_analysis.method: Comparison using IAFIS database and manual Henry classification
findings: Fingerprint from main door handle: MATCHES right thumb of accused Ravi Shankar Yadav (12-point match)
Fingerprint from almirah handle: MATCHES right index finger of accused (14-point match)
Fingerprint from bedroom door: MATCHES left middle finger of accused (11-point match)
All 3 fingerprints do not match victim or witness prints
Two additional partial prints (insufficient for identification) from almirah area
fingerprint_analysis.conclusion: Three clear fingerprint impressions from the crime scene conclusively match the accused Ravi Shankar Yadav, establishing his physical presence at the scene.

tool_mark_analysis.method: Comparison microscopy of tool marks on padlock and almirah with iron rod
findings: Pry marks on padlock hasp: consistent with iron rod tip pattern
Cut marks on padlock body: fine striations match iron rod edge
Almirah door edge marks: match iron rod tip width (matching both crime scene rod and recovered rod)
Both iron rods (crime scene and recovered) show identical tip deformation - one is likely a duplicate or the tool was used consistently
tool_mark_analysis.conclusion: The iron rod found at scene and the iron rod recovered from accused exhibit identical tool marks to those found on the broken padlock and almirah. This conclusively links both rods to the crime and to the accused.

footprint_analysis.method: Comparative analysis of plaster cast with accused's footwear
findings: Accused's seized footwear (one pair dark sports shoes size 9) matches the sole pattern and wear marks
footprint_analysis.conclusion: The footprint at scene matches accused's footwear.

cctv_enhancement.method: Digital enhancement and face comparison analysis
findings: 14:20:15 footage: Individual entering building - face partially captured
Facial features (nose, chin, eyebrow shape) consistent with accused's photograph
Body features: height ~5'6", medium build, dark complexion, black t-shirt with visible logo
14:52:40 footage: Same individual exiting with black bag
Gait analysis: unique limp on right leg (accused has documented history of right knee injury from 2019)
cctv_enhancement.conclusion: CCTV footage clearly identifies accused Ravi Shankar Yadav entering and exiting building at time of crime. Gait analysis provides additional positive identification.

findings: Black fibre fragments recovered from broken almirah area match material of accused's seized bag

final_opinion.summary: Forensic analysis provides conclusive evidence linking accused Ravi Shankar Yadav to the crime scene through multiple independent scientific parameters - fingerprint match, tool mark match, footwear match, and CCTV identification.
chain_of_evidence: Tool marks: Iron rod recovered from accused matches crime scene marks
Footwear: Sole pattern matches accused's footwear
final_opinion.expert_opinion: In the considered opinion of the undersigned, the accused Ravi Shankar Yadav was physically present at the crime scene (Flat 302, Rishi Apartments) on 20-11-2024 between 14:20 and 14:52 hours and used the seized iron rod to commit house-breaking and theft as described in the FIR.
